preview: FAFSA GRADUATION REQUIREMENT The Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) is an application used by colleges and other post-secondary institutions to determine a student’s eligibility for need-based federal financial aid such as grants, loans and work-study programs. In accordance with Public Act 101-0180, students must complete one of the following steps in order to graduate from an Illinois public high school: ■ File a FAFSA; OR ■ File an alternative application for Illinois Financial
